newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD MEN'S DISCUS CHAMPION RIEDEL.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD MEN'S DISCUS CHAMPION RIEDEL.

text.p: Profile of Lars Riedel, who won the world men's discus title on Sunday.
Won the last three world titles.
Started last year's Olympic final with two fouls before winning with a throw at 69.40 metres, the longest ever at an Olympics or world championships.
The former East German did not qualify for the final of the 1992 Olympics and had a groin injury in 1994.
Broke his personal record with the third longest throw ever of 71.50 metres last May in Wiesbaden.
